title: REALBIL - Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Efficacy of Oncological Therapies in Patients with Biliary Tract Cancer
summary: Although clinical trials have established the efficacy of various systemic therapies in patients with biliary carcinomas, their effectiveness outside of these trials remains unknown. A detailed examination of real-world clinical treatment data can provide important insights for clinical practice.
conditions: Patients with biliary tract cancers will be examined (ICD codes C22-C24)

interventions.name: Patients with confirmed biliary tract cancer will be examined.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed diagnosis of biliary tract carcinoma
Diagnosis between January 1, 2012 and December 31, 2024
At least one line of systemic therapy OR a follow-up of at least 12 months after diagnosis
Exclusion criteria:
Failure to meet the inclusion criteria
